title: leagues design-review amendments
acceptance: GET /leagues accepts sortDirection (asc|desc) and sortBy gains igReach; the reply row gains igReach (sum of tracked athletes' IG followers) with a schema description stating it is not a deduplicated audience; OpenAPI snapshot, api-client, and module tests updated; api lint/typecheck/test pass

The leagues table shows two new right-aligned sortable columns - Athletes (trackedAthletes) and IG Reach (igReach, compact-formatted) - and the League/Competition column sorts again; a test clicks each sortable header and asserts aria-sort flips between ascending and descending

Sport labels are capitalized in every surface: the league identity cell and the sport filter pills render through a shared display-label formatter beside getSportColor in apps/web/src/pages/sports/, never the raw API value

Key Athletes and Nationalities cells share one text size; the nationalities overflow tooltip is a themed Mantine surface capped at 10 items with a localized ellipsis line stating how many more exist, and a test asserts the cap
The REACH pill group is labeled IG Reach, and the IG Reach column header carries a tooltip defining the aggregation; all new or changed strings go through Lingui and are translated in all 7 locales
pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, and pnpm build pass; pnpm generate:api-client artifacts are regenerated in this change
notes: Executes the PRD amendment 'design review notes (2026-08-19)' and the phase-05 P1 (sortDirection missing left the league sort header inert). Read docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md 'Data display integrity' - these five rules ARE the acceptance intent. Model sortDirection on athletes (ASCENDING_FIRST set, no schema default, per-column resolution); asc-first: name, sport; desc-first: trackedAthletes, igReach. The igReach aggregate already exists query-side for the REACH threshold filter - expose it in the SELECT and reply rather than recomputing. Column tooltip copy: 'Sum of tracked athletes' Instagram followers - not a deduplicated audience.' The design-language learned rule applies: a test for a sortable header must click it and assert aria-sort changes, not assert the rest state. SQL for the new sort and the widened SELECT must be executed against real ClickHouse via the read-only MCP after the phase by the driver session (writers have no MCP access); do not add a script.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- docs/BACKLOG.md:10 — out-of-scope harness-written entry records a P1 (`OrderableChain` builder escape hatch) that this same diff already fixed by moving the interface to `apps/api/src/lib/database.ts`; landing it adds a stale P1 the next `/backlog` run has to re-triage — delete or amend the entry before committing.
- apps/api/src/lib/database.ts:38 — outside the phase's declared globs, but `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:143-146` (CRITICAL) requires builder-typing workarounds to live in the database layer, so `OrderableChain` is unavoidable wiring; accept it and add `apps/api/src/lib/**` to the phase's `files` list, as was already done for `packages/ui/components/data-table/**`.
- apps/api/src/modules/leagues/routes/list-leagues/queries.ts:216,240 — the widened SELECT (`league_athletes.aggregated_ig_followers`) and the new `ifNull(...)` ORDER BY expression over a joined CTE alias are proven only by asserted SQL strings; the learned rule requires the filter/sort matrix and the count/list sibling pair to execute against real ClickHouse. The read-only MCP is not reachable from this review session, so this is still outstanding — run it and report row counts before pushing (do not add a script).
- packages/ui/components/data-table/DataTable.tsx:187 — the `Tooltip` wraps the non-focusable `Box`, not the `UnstyledButton` inside it, so keyboard focus on the sort button never opens the definition; a sighted keyboard user cannot reach it at all. Put the tooltip on the interactive element (or add the definition to the button's accessible name) rather than only on hover plus a `VisuallyHidden` copy.
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/components/LeagueCells/OverflowCount.tsx:14 — `TOOLTIP_WIDTH = 240` is restated verbatim in `packages/ui/components/data-table/DataTable.tsx:54`; two multiline tooltip surfaces that are meant to look alike now drift independently. Give the value one exported owner in the UI package and import it.

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- P3 — hoist the asc/desc sort-direction TypeBox union into `apps/api/src/lib/pagination.ts`; `schemas.ts:18` is now the third verbatim copy (artists, athletes, leagues).
- P3 — msgid "Athletes" now serves the leagues column header, the leagues threshold pill group, and the athletes table; add distinguishing Lingui `comment:` context so one translation is not forced on three meanings.
- P3 — filter–column parity (docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md): the leagues "Mega only" filter still has no visible column, so its effect stays unverifiable.
